dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: #Ah, it's you, {NICKNAME}. Sorry, I didn't realize you were here...

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: This resort is huge, and there's barely anyone I recognize. Luckily, I've run into you. Are you out sightseeing?

choices.text: I'm here to take pictures of the resort.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Pictures...? Don't you need a Kamera for that? I don't see one on you...

choices.text: I'm here to take pictures of you.
